sections.name: Versioning

rules.requirement: use URL path versioning with /v{N}/ prefix
remove endpoints without 6 month deprecation notice

notes: from RFC-12: header-based versioning rejected due to CDN caching issues

sections.name: Authentication

rules.requirement: verify issuer, audience, and expiry on every request
accept API keys as sole authentication method

notes: security audit finding SA-2026-03: 12% of endpoints were missing audience validation

sections.name: Rate Limiting

rules.requirement: enforce 1000 requests per minute per client
enforce 5000 requests per minute per service
allow burst up to 2x limit for 30 second windows

notes: Slack discussion: team agreed on these numbers after the March 3 incident

rules.requirement: expose internal stack traces or database errors
